lines.text: You just checked your phone. Again. Not because something happened. Because something might have. Your brain loves a maybe. A slot machine works the same way. Most pulls give you nothing. But one random win keeps you pulling. Every notification is a tiny pull of the lever. So next time you reach for it, ask one question. Am I checking it... or is it checking me?
lines.style: natural, conversational, well paced, small pauses between sentences, playful at the end
